queries: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), all_album_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond, a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond - g.rate AS above_all_album_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN all_album_avg AS g WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY above_all_album_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: An album's rate is the average of its track rates; each AlbumId group, including the NULL group, has equal weight in the all-album average. Tracks with missing Bytes or zero Milliseconds do not contribute a rate.

alternatives.interpretation: An album's bytes-per-millisecond rate is its total bytes divided by its total duration, using tracks with known Bytes and nonzero Milliseconds.
